TowerBFT vote tower checks, serialization, checkpointing, and restore APIs.

# Purpose
`fd_tower.h` defines the TowerBFT API used by the validator consensus logic in Solana. It declares the `fd_tower_t` vote tower data model, the vote deque storage, and the zero-copy serialization schemas used for TowerSync transactions and checkpoint files. The file also provides functions to create, join, vote, check lockout and switch rules, compute the reset and vote slots, and verify tower state against `fd_ghost_t` and epoch data. In addition, it includes helpers for checkpointing, restoring, printing, and loading tower state from vote account data.
